goal: Iske baad aap samjha sakte hain ke related data ko ek jagah kyun group karna chahiye, bata sakte hain ke struct kya hai, aur struct aur array ka farq bata sakte hain.
warmup: Apne CNIC card ke bare mein sochein. Us par aap ka naam, CNIC number, tareekh-e-paidaish aur address hota hai. Chaar baatein, lekin card EK. Koi aap ka naam ek drawer mein, number doosre mein aur address teesre mein nahi rakhta. Ab canteen ke register ke bare mein sochein jis mein har row ek student hai: roll number, naam, marks. Ek row ek record hai. Struct C++ ko poori row ek cheez ki tarah rakhne deta hai.
definition: Array bohat si values rakhta hai jo ek HI type ki hon. Lekin asli cheezon ke kai facts DIFFERENT types ke hote hain: student ka ek id (int), ek naam (string) aur ek CGPA (double) hota hai. Structure, jo struct likha jata hai, aise related variables ko ek naam ke neeche group karta hai. Yeh user-defined data type hai: aap type design karte hain, phir uske variables banate hain. Uske andar ke variables data members kehlate hain. Ek struct variable ek record hai, table ki ek row ki tarah.
howItWorks: Pehla trace dekhein. Hum teen students ko teen parallel arrays mein rakhte hain: ids, names, CGPAs. Yeh tab tak chalta hai jab tak kisi student ko move na karna pare. Do students ko swap karne ke liye hamein har array mein swap karna parta hai, teen temporary variables ke saath. Agar ek line bhool jayein to Ali ka naam Usman ke marks ke saath chala jata hai aur program phir bhi compile hota hai: ek khamosh bug. Students ko sort karne, delete karne ya insert karne mein bhi yehi masla hai. Ab doosra trace dekhein. Student naam ke struct ke saath, ek variable id, naam aur CGPA ko ek saath rakhta hai. Do students ko swap karna wohi aam teen lines hain, nau nahi, aur facts kabhi alag nahi ho sakte. Struct array nahi hai. Array: bohat se items, ek hi type, index se milte hain (marks[2]). Struct: kuch items, kisi bhi type ke, naam se milte hain (s1.cgpa). Aap dono ko mila sakte hain: structs ka ARRAY poora class register hai (Week 12, lesson 4). Struct type declare karna sirf naqsha banata hai, CNIC card ke design ki tarah. Memory tab milti hai jab aap us type ka variable banate hain. Memory visual ek struct variable ke members ko ek dusre ke saath saath rakha hua dikhata hai.
